publication_transform: Retain every method ID, outcome, verdict, contract, oracle, finding and limitation.
Store methods once as TSV; omit repeated historical capability navigation already published with the previous audit.
Rewrite local evidence references to repository-contained derivatives; normalize machine paths in stored tracebacks.
Preserve withdrawn findings and the reason for each reclassification.
Exclude raw lane inputs, duplicate draft builders, bulk CI logs and copied source trees.

availability.repository_contained: Method table, findings, frozen compact probes and original-review scope receipts
availability.public_ci: Original execution run and fixed source links
availability.local_only: Full audit inputs, draft builders, unabridged author/reviewer work records and bulk CI logs; hashes are identities, not retrieval links
